messages:
maria: Heads-up — I'm opening a quick PR to fix a couple of console presets that broke after the SDK param rename. Not a big change but want a quick smoke test before merge.

jack: Thanks, can you drop the PR link? I'll run the local sample harness.

maria: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/7283 — it's tiny, mainly updates to the dashboard preset JSON and the Node/Go snippets.

sasha: quick question — did you keep the old traceKey fallback? A bunch of our dashboards still expect trace_id.

maria: Good catch. I added a compatibility shim in examples: we accept both trace_id and traceKey, prefer traceKey. Snippet: ```js
const traceId = ctx.traceKey || ctx.trace_id;
// attach to span
```

oliver: I ran the smoke locally against staging console and noticed the cost/latency breakdown widget throws on empty samples. Might be an edge case when prefetch returns null.

maria: Ah yes — the preset expects metric labels to exist. I'll add a guard and default empty buckets. Should I also add a short note in the migration guide about the metric rename + empty-bucket behavior?

jack: Please do. Add a one-paragraph callout under "Dashboards: migration notes" and link the fix in the PR. That helps support when customers hit it.

sasha: Also, small nit: the Go SDK snippet uses the old GetTrace() helper name. We moved it to TraceFromContext(). Can we update both Go and Rust examples?

maria: Yep will update Go + Rust. Will include a one-liner compatibility note: "older SDKs expose GetTrace(); prefer TraceFromContext() on >=v2.4".

docs-bot: Reminder: docs CI will run spellcheck + sample-lint when PR opened.

maria: CI green locally. I still want someone to sanity-check the console layout before merge — if we accidentally renamed a panel id it could hide a graph.

oliver: I can eyeball it in staging at 14:30 PT. If you tag me @oliver I'll do a quick run through dashboards + cost widget.

maria: Tagged. Also adding a tiny devex note showing how to reproduce the bug: run the sample presubmit script: `./scripts/sample-load --preset=observability_console_test --env=staging`

jack: After the checks, please ping me and I'll do a docs copy pass (links + phrasing).

maria: Will do. Thanks everyone — aiming to merge EOD if no surprises.

oliver: Quick follow-up after manual run: cost widget no longer crashes on empty samples, but legend order changed. That might confuse internal dashboards. Opening a follow-up PR to keep old ordering stable.

maria: Perfect — if you link that PR I'll add the follow-up note to the migration doc.

jack: One more ask — add a short test snippet that asserts the trace header fallback to catch regressions. Even a unit test in the examples repo is fine.

maria: Adding a tiny Jest test. Example: ```js
expect(normalizeTrace({ trace_id: 'abc'})).toEqual('abc');
expect(normalizeTrace({ traceKey: 'def'})).toEqual('def');
```

sasha: LGTM for content. Thanks for handling the compatibility bits.

maria: Merge planned after oliver's dashboard ordering PR and jack's copy pass. I'll update the thread when merged. :party-parrot:
